headline: China State Funds Pour Into ETFs as Stock Market Slips
summary: China's state-backed 'national team' poured about 170 billion yuan into exchange-traded funds as the country's stock market slipped into a bear market.
why: State interventions in Chinese equity markets are deployed by authorities to stabilize asset prices and restore investor confidence during downturns.

impacts.name: Chinese Equities
impacts.why: Direct state capital injections into exchange-traded funds provide artificial buying support to equities.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Substantial state-backed capital deployment directly absorbs selling pressure in domestic equity exchange-traded funds.
